meta.name: use-native-credential-proxy
meta.description: Opt out of the OneCLI gateway and supply Anthropic credentials from .env instead. For users who want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault. Reads the API key or OAuth token from .env and injects it into the container's API requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Read credentials from .env and inject into API requests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault

howto.what: 启用后,Claude会直接读取项目根目录.env里的Anthropic凭证(API密钥或OAuth令牌),并注入容器环境变量,让API请求绕过OneCLI网关。未启用开关时行为不变。
howto.when: 当你在.env中设置NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true,并配置ANTHROPIC_API_KEY、CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN等凭证后,重启服务即触发;未设置则不生效。

howto.what_en: After enabling, Claude reads Anthropic credentials (API key or OAuth token) directly from .env, injects them into the container env, bypassing the OneCLI gateway. Without the flag, behavior is unchanged.
howto.when_en: Triggered when NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true is set in .env with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, etc., after service restart. No effect without the flag.
